source: Owner requested matching the supplied Chavet photograph's measured relative heights; sliders use the nearest available whole percent.
scale_basis: Slider percentages of the model-estimated starting sizes in scale.json; image proportions are preserved.
note: Approximate Chavet photo heights relative to its king: queen 85.1%, bishop 72.0%, knight 68.3%, rook 59.9%, pawn 53.1%. Slider steps are whole percentages. Reset restores this preset; the revision gives saved browser settings a fresh namespace. These are display defaults, not changes to model geometry.
